key_card.title: Pair using Key Card
key_card.description:
Scan the QR code on the Eqiva Key Card with a QR code scanner and paste the complete result into the field below. Then hold the unlock button on the lock until the yellow LED flashes and confirm with OK. The QR code data is not stored after successful pairing.

Technical diagnosis: {error}

data_description.connection_mode: Energy saving connects only when needed. Live keeps the BLE connection open, so commands reach the lock without reconnecting and manual lock changes can be reported immediately in Home Assistant.
data_description.knx_enabled: Uses Home Assistant's existing KNX/IP connection. No second KNX tunnel is opened. The group-address fields appear in the Configuration section of the device page after setup.

error.not_found: The lock was not found after a 10 second active Bluetooth scan and no Eqiva advertisement with manufacturer ID 0x1A00 was received.
error.no_scanner: Home Assistant has no connectable Bluetooth adapter or active Bluetooth proxy.
error.address_mismatch: An Eqiva lock was found under a different Bluetooth address. Check the MAC address from the Key Card or ESP configuration.
error.invalid_key_card: The Key Card data is invalid.
error.pairing_failed: Bluetooth and the KeyBLE handshake work, but pairing failed. Check the Key Card and pairing mode.
error.cannot_connect: Unexpected error while accessing the lock. The technical diagnosis below contains more detail.
error.connection_failed: Bluetooth connection to the lock or access to the Eqiva GATT profile failed.
error.handshake_failed: Bluetooth is connected, but the lock did not answer the KeyBLE connection handshake. Close the Eqiva app and temporarily stop other KeyBLE bridges.

abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device is not a supported Eqiva lock.

options.polling: Energy saving – connect only when needed

invalid_knx_group_address.message: Invalid KNX group address. Examples: 1/2/3, 1/123 or 1234.

duplicate_knx_group_address.message: This KNX group address is already assigned to another function.

init.title: Eqiva lock options
init.description: Configure Bluetooth and enable the optional connection to the existing Home Assistant KNX/IP integration. After KNX is enabled, group addresses can be edited in the Configuration section of the device page.

data_description.connection_mode: Live mode keeps the KeyBLE connection open. An automatic status keepalive at least every 3 minutes prevents the lock's idle timeout; manual changes are reported immediately and genuine disconnects are reconnected automatically. Other Bluetooth clients such as the Eqiva app cannot connect at the same time.
data_description.poll_interval: Time between status synchronizations in energy-saving mode. Live mode uses only the automatic 3-minute keepalive, so this option is hidden there.
data_description.knx_enabled: Uses Home Assistant's existing KNX/IP connection. No second KNX tunnel is opened. Group addresses appear on the device page after enabling KNX.
